summary: Interval decrease in bilateral lower-predominant pulmonary edema, greater on the right, with residual left basilar opacity.

findings.rationale: After matching the prior and current lungs, there is visible clearing of the prior bilateral lower and perihilar hazy airspace opacity, most conspicuously in the right mid/lower lung, while residual opacity remains at the left base; this exceeds what would be expected from the small projection differences.
